negative_findings.description: Bankart publishes no 'Partnerji' / 'Partners' or 'Reference' page, and no client-bank list. Repeated SL and EN queries for Bankart partner/technology pages returned only service, careers and news pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: The cell's expected 'partner/technology page' artefact does not exist for the single most important actor; partner identity must be reconstructed from news items, supplier case studies and owner-bank disclosures.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection design that assumes a scrapeable Bankart partner directory will silently return nothing; budget must move to supplier-side and press-release harvesting instead.

negative_findings.description: Searches for Bankart tenders/RFPs ('javno narocilo', 'razpis', 'dobavitelj') found no procurement notices. Bankart is a bank-owned private company and is not visible as a contracting authority on enarocanje.si in these results.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public tender trail for the country's main processor; its vendor purchases are commercially confidential.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bankart's supplier set can only be inferred indirectly (vendor case studies, trade press, job ads), so confidence on stack claims will stay medium at best.

negative_findings.description: The Flik participant-bank list is consistently referenced ('seznam bank najdete na www.flik.si') by Bankart and by member banks, but the exact URL of that list page was not isolated in this pass — only flik.si root and /pravne-osebe surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pointer confirmed to exist; its precise address unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This list is the highest-value single artefact in the cell (full instant-payments participant graph); the next pass should crawl flik.si directly rather than rely on search.

negative_findings.description: Several Banka Slovenije payment-system pages surfaced on a staging-style host (bsi.azurewebsites.net) rather than www.bsi.si, and bsi.si URL paths appear in two forms (with and without an /sl/ segment).
negative_findings.result_summary: Canonical URLs for BSI payment-system pages are uncertain; some recorded URLs may redirect.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Liveness verification may report false 404s for BSI paths; the verifier should follow redirects and treat the azurewebsites host as non-canonical.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language term was found for a 'scheme technology partner programme' equivalent (e.g. certified-vendor / partner-programme listings) for Flik or the national rails; searches in SL returned only consumer and bank-facing content.
negative_findings.result_summary: The SI schemes appear not to run public certified-vendor programmes, unlike card schemes internationally.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor certification lists — a standard high-yield source type elsewhere — are likely absent for SI national schemes, and effort should not be spent hunting them.

coverage_gaps.description: flik.si was not crawled directly in this pass; its participant list, merchant/acquirer pages and any technical documentation remain unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl https://www.flik.si/ end-to-end (SL), enumerating bank listings, business/merchant pages and any rulebook or integration docs.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian payments-adjacent operators and vendors not covered here: Halcom (e-banking/payments software), Bankhub/Bankart competitors in acquiring, Nexi/Nets local presence, Mastercard/Visa SI country offices, and Trgovinska/POS acquirers. These sit at the boundary of the cell but were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on SI payments software vendors and acquirers with SL terms: 'ponudnik placilnih resitev', 'POS terminali', 'pridobitelj kartic', 'e-banka programska oprema'.

coverage_gaps.description: The BSI 'upravljavci placilnih sistemov' register and the BSI publications index were identified from search snippets but not fetched, so their actual content and update cadence are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse both pages; establish whether the operator register is a static list or a queryable register, and locate the annual payment/settlement systems report series index.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/temporal source was established for these sites (e.g. Wayback snapshots of bankart.si service pages or flik.si participant lists), so historical change detection would start from zero.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed the collection with Internet Archive snapshots for bankart.si, flik.si and the BSI payment-system pages to backfill a change timeline.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian business/financial media (Delo, Finance.si, Racunalniske novice interviews) were only touched incidentally; they are the main channel where Bankart executives discuss roadmap and vendor choices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a SL media-monitoring pass with entity queries on 'Bankart', 'Flik', 'BIPS', 'takojsnja placila' across finance.si, delo.si and IT trade outlets; note most are paywalled.

brief: Slovenia's payment-infrastructure layer is unusually concentrated and unusually well-documented by regulators rather than by the operators themselves: Bankart d.o.o. — bank-owned, running card processing plus the SIMP-PS, BIPS and Flik rails — is the single hub, and Banka Slovenije is the authoritative publisher of who operates and participates in each system (upravljavci placilnih sistemov register, National Payments Council materials, annual payment/settlement reports), while also directly operating SISBON and SISBIZ. The key structural finding is that Bankart publishes no partner, client or reference list at all, so its vendor graph must be reconstructed indirectly — from supplier-side case studies (IBM, Nets/Nexi via trade press), owner-bank disclosures (NLB Group), its own /aktualno announcements (e.g. Rekono), job ads, and public-money trails on ERAR and enarocanje.si. The highest-value unresolved pointer is the Flik participant-bank list on flik.si, which every bank and Bankart page defers to and which maps the entire instant-payments participant set. All Slovenian-language searching was productive and mandatory here: the operator, register and scheme vocabulary (upravljavec, udelezenci, placilni promet, procesni center) surfaces material that English queries do not reach.
